messages:
Josue (PM): Quick sync: DeltaBank trial timeline and owners. Need confirmations on deliverables and any blockers. Success criteria: 1) SSO + encrypted payload demo, 2) <=2s p99 inference at trial load, 3) audit logs + retention per contract. Owners I have: Lara - SE (adapter & sample app), Matt D (infra & dedicated), Erin (TLS/network), Olivia CS (customer coord). Please ack or correct.

Lara - SE: Ack. Quick question: DeltaBank will prefer SAML or OIDC for SSO? That changes sample app flow. Also they want HMAC-SHA256 for webhook signing. Example header we'll validate: `x-db-signature: sha256=...`. ETA for adapter MVP: dev 2024-03-18, test 2024-03-20.

Matt D: Can provision dedicated capacity and pin model variant. Infra tasks: reserve capacity + warmup (ETA 3/18), set autoscale safety limits. Blocker: need static egress IPs from DeltaBank for callbacks OR we use our proxy. If static IPs required, need list ASAP.

Erin (infra): I'll upload TLS certs and configure ingress once we have customer CIDRs. Opening network ticket now. If we use proxy for callbacks, we need to plan secret rotation window.

Olivia CS: I'll request a sanitized test dataset and the security contact. Target to get data by 3/19 so we can validate retention and audit samples. Customer wants to see perf numbers + sample logs.

Lara - SE: Also need code review for sample app PR #452 (touches auth/token exchange). Reviewer request: @Matt D and @Erin (infra).

Matt D: Will review PR tonight. Note: routing policy for trial should prefer `low-latency` zone; config at `infra/config/deltabank_trial.yaml`.

Erin (infra): Routing config nit: cert path should be `secrets/tls/deltabank.crt`. I'll patch after PR approved. Opened firewall ticket NET-2217 for DeltaBank IPs.

Lara - SE: Integration details: webhook POST /events JSON, auth `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Test curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://integration.redwood.internal/events \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer test_token" \\
  -d '{"event":"inference","payload":{"text":"hi"}}'
```

Olivia CS: DeltaBank security said token auth + HMAC preferred. I'll confirm final scheme by EOD tomorrow.

Josue (PM): Proposed demo dates: internal dry-run 2024-03-25, customer demo 2024-03-30. Can owners confirm or suggest alternatives?

Matt D: 3/25 dry-run OK for infra baseline. Need customer IPs by 3/19 to finish whitelist.

Lara - SE: Plan: finish integration tests 3/20, sample app + docs 3/22, dry-run 3/25. Will need CR approved by 3/20.

Erin (infra): Certs + firewall targeted for 3/19. If IPs delayed, push demo by a week.

Olivia CS: Pushing for datasets by 3/19 and security sign-off by 3/22. Scheduling customer rehearsal 3/28 as backup.

Matt D: Reviewed PR #452, left two minor nits (header parsing + test vector). Will approve after fixes. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: delta-poc-service v1.3.0 -> canary (2024-03-21T22:00:00Z). Use `/deploy status delta-poc-service` to check.

Erin (infra): Canary looks green from readiness probes. I'll monitor p99 latency overnight and report by 3/22 AM.

Lara - SE: Quick doc ask: can infra list expected error codes for sample app (e.g., 401/403 auth, 429 rate limit)? I will add to README.

Matt D: Error codes: 401/403 auth, 429 rate limit, 503 model overload, 502 upstream. Will update docs after canary confirmed.

Josue (PM): Outstanding items I see: DeltaBank to provide IPs + sanitized data (Olivia), PR #452 fixes (Lara + Matt), NET-2217 firewall (Erin), canary + latency report (Erin/Matt). If owners confirm and check tickets, I'll lock 3/25 dry-run.

Lara - SE: Confirmed PR fixes & schedule. :white_check_mark:

Matt D: Confirmed infra tasks & will post latency report by 3/22 AM. :rocket:

Olivia CS: Following up with DeltaBank today; will post contact + dataset ETA. :phone:

Erin (infra): NET-2217 opened, awaiting IPs. :eyes:

Josue (PM): Thanks everyone. I'll update project board and send calendar invites for 3/25. Post slips here so we can re-plan.

Lara - SE: Ping to @Matt D for final CR approval when you have a minute.

Matt D: Approved after fix; merging PR.

Erin (infra): Latency report (overnight): p99 ~1.8s on canary under trial load. No errors above baseline. Will keep monitoring.

Olivia CS: DeltaBank confirmed they can provide CIDRs by EOD and a sanitized dataset on 3/19. Scheduling customer security call for 3/22.

Josue (PM): Locking internal dry-run for 3/25. If anything changes post security call, update this thread. Thanks!
